description: Provision an Azure Entra Application via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the entra.azure.com/v1 Application spec.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.

groupMembershipClaims.description: GroupMembershipClaims: Configures the groups claim issued in a user or OAuth 2.0 access token.

creationMode.description:
CreationMode: Specifies how ASO will try to create the resource.
Specify "AlwaysCreate" to always create a new application when first reconciled.
Or specify "AdoptOrCreate" to first try to adopt an existing application with the same display name.
If multiple applications with the same display name are found, the resource ready condition will show an error.
If not specified, defaults to "AdoptOrCreate".
